about: a residential solar company's home page with products, financing and reviews

responses.body:
Home Products Financing About Contact

Solar panels for Arizona homes

Northwind Solar designs and installs residential solar systems in Phoenix, Tempe and Mesa. Average customers cut their power bill by 70% and recover the cost in seven years.

Products

  • Monocrystalline panels, 430 W
  • Home battery storage, 13.5 kWh
  • EV charger installation

Financing

$0 down solar loans, the 30% federal tax credit and SRP net metering explained.

Why us

25-year warranty, NABCEP-certified installers, 4.9 stars from 1,200 reviews.

© 2026 Northwind Solar LLC, 2100 E Camelback Rd, Phoenix AZ

connector.none: no captured connector fetches web pages

reads.note: HTTP Request v4.2 GET of the submitted URL (the form field's label has a trailing space: 'Website Name ')

fields.Keywords: solar panels arizona, residential solar phoenix, …

writeReplies.note: Airtable v2.1 record upsert matching 'WebSite Name': PATCH https://api.airtable.com/v0/<base>/<table> {typecast: false, performUpsert: {fieldsToMergeOn: ['WebSite Name']}, records: [{fields}]} (n8n-nodes-base 2.47.7 upsert.operation, batchUpdate); the form answers with the last node's output (responseMode lastNode)

branches: no IF/Switch; Merge (SQL, the default LEFT JOIN on fields neither side has) hands the keyword list on
expect.offline: The keywords and topics come from the stand-in model (gpt-5-mini in the template). Wait1 holds the second branch 20 seconds. The form's reply is the Airtable record
